description: Find slots that can take a given party (participant counts per category, options, resources), with an estimated price. Works for all product types, including flexibleTime appointments. Window max 31 days. To page through results pass only pageNavigationToken (+ pageNumber). Read-only. Bookeo: POST /availability/matchingslots, GET /availability/matchingslots/{pageNavigationToken}.

endTime.description: Search window end, max 31 days after start (required for a new search) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

pageNavigationToken.description: To fetch another page of a previous search: its info.pageNavigationToken. The other search fields are then ignored.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

peopleNumbers.description: Participant counts per people category (required for a new search).

number.description: How many people of this category.

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

productId.description: Product id (required for a new search).

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

startTime.description: Search window start (required for a new search) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

name: bookeo_search_matching_slots
title: Search matching slots
